description: Bounded exact GPSR perimeter face traversal with explicit Lf crossing events on a supplied planar embedding.

source.title: GPSR: Greedy Perimeter Stateless Routing for Wireless Networks
source.algorithm_attribution: Right-hand perimeter traversal, face-change progress using Lf, and Lp recovery test
source.implementation_status: clean-room bounded profile; supplied embedding; no source code or source fixtures copied

input.encoding: [n,m,source,target,x[n],y[n],(u,v)[m]]; edge IDs are their lexicographic positions
input.geometry_rule: Distinct coordinates; no three vertices collinear; nonincident straight edges do not intersect.
input.graph_rule: Simple connected undirected graph; each edge is u<v; edge pairs are strictly lexicographically ordered.
input.source_rule: source != target and no source neighbor is strictly closer to target in squared Euclidean distance.

status_values.0: the first directed edge of a face was selected again
status_values.1: first vertex strictly closer to target than Lp

output.crossing_rule: Each crossing is a proper intersection of a candidate edge with Lp-to-target whose reduced parameter is strictly greater than Lf; the event is recorded before advancing one CCW edge at the current vertex.

workspace.meaning: Fixed payload includes coordinates, edges, adjacency/rotations, degrees, queue/visited state, route/event records and staged output; the cap adds locals and vector capacity rounding.

contract.initial_edge: Choose the first incident edge strictly counterclockwise from the ray source-to-target.
contract.right_hand_rule: After arrival from a vertex, choose the next incident edge counterclockwise from the outgoing reverse dart.
contract.face_change: At the current vertex, while the selected candidate edge intersects Lp-to-target at t>Lf, set Lf=t, record the event, then advance to the next CCW edge at the same vertex. Reset e0 to the selected directed edge after a face change.
contract.recovery: Stop at the first current vertex with squared target distance strictly below the source/Lp target distance; this records return to greedy mode and does not execute greedy forwarding.
contract.drop: Stop when the selected directed e0 edge is encountered again without a face change.
contract.bounds: At most 2m directed hops and m strict-progress crossings; n<=8 and m<=18.
